provisions.instrument: Personal Protective Equipment at Work Regulations 1992
provisions.summary: Employer must provide suitable personal protective equipment where risks are not adequately controlled by other means.

provisions.instrument: Personal Protective Equipment at Work Regulations 1992
provisions.summary: Personal protective equipment must be maintained in efficient working order and good repair.

provisions.instrument: Personal Protective Equipment at Work Regulations 1992
provisions.summary: Every employee must use the personal protective equipment provided in accordance with training and instruction.

provisions.instrument: Management of Health and Safety at Work Regulations 1999
provisions.summary: Employer must make a suitable and sufficient assessment of the risks to health and safety.

provisions.instrument: Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974
provisions.summary: General duty to ensure, so far as is reasonably practicable, the health, safety and welfare of employees.
